WAREHOUSE INTEROPERABILITY PLANE, re-derived under contract nyc_dcp_mappluto_geometry_evidence.v3. Same projection as nyc_dcp_mappluto_ext plus the geometry-evidence columns, but every row was produced by the PINNED coordinate operation named in its transform receipt (NAD83 to WGS 84 via the HPGN grid, declared 2.0 m) rather than the null transform (declared 4.0 m) that produced nyc_dcp_mappluto_ext. The two tables differ by roughly 5 cm per parcel and are deliberately kept separate so a query can never mix coordinate operations. This is the plane new work should read; nyc_dcp_mappluto_hot and the OC-0048 consumers have NOT been cut over to it yet.

SOURCE EVIDENCE PLANE. Row-addressable source-coordinate geometry for every admitted MapPLUTO feature, captured BEFORE reprojection, plus the WGS84 derivation and both digests. source_geom_wkb is a deterministic decoding of the retained provider archive under contract nyc_dcp_mappluto_geometry_evidence.v1 - it is NOT the provider's original byte stream, and its hash proves equality of that pinned representation, not world truth. Authority for the source bytes stays with the artifact=raw object named by source_archive_s3_key / source_archive_sha256. Scan only via the bounded locator from nyc_dcp_mappluto_ext; never sweep it whole.

TRANSFORM RECEIPTS. One row per release/variant transform execution, naming the exact coordinate operation applied (PROJ pipeline, declared accuracy, selection rule), the sha256 of every PROJ grid it depended on, the pinned decoder/engine/CRS-database versions, and the observed feature and vertex counts with source and derived digest chains. Rows in the geometry tables reference transform_execution_id rather than duplicating this document. Two ids: transform_execution_id is unique per release and source archive and is the join key; transform_definition_id addresses the pinned operation alone and is SHARED by releases transformed identically, so joining on it alone fans out across releases. degraded_transform_accepted = TRUE means a more accurate operation existed but its grids were absent from that runtime - treat those coordinates accordingly.

One JSON receipt per (release, transform execution): the pinned PROJ operation, pipeline, grids and their digests, engine versions, serialization policy, and observed feature/vertex counts with digest chains. Join geometry rows on transform_execution_id; transform_definition_id is a sameness claim shared across releases.

two-parcel PIP; */ /* * 54,344 H3-blocked pairs, 148 PIP pairs, 10..1,242 blocked per subject; */ /* * the four misses are 3.006..22.221 m from the nearest blocked parcel; */ /*   none is rescued by an invalid-retained source geometry. */ WITH params AS (SELECT CAST('dd644d67-070c-4824-a2a6-bbc8b625a402' AS VARCHAR) AS bridge_build_id, CAST('39049' AS VARCHAR) AS county_fips, params) AND p.release_dt = (SELECT parcel_release_dt FROM params) AND p.county_fips = (SELECT county_fips FROM params) AND p.provider_feature_id = c.provider_feature_id), pip_pairs AS (SELECT c.property_key, c.provider_feature_id FROM candidate_features AS c JOIN admissible_parcels AS p ON p.provider_feature_id = c.provider_feature_id WHERE ST_CONTAINS(p.geom_geog, c.point_geog)), The selection is seeded over */ /* the live admitted PIP population; no property or parcel id is hard-coded. */ /* The 10,000-foot grid coordinates are part of frame_id, so the explicit */ /* source-plane origin cannot silently drift when other evidence accretes. */ /* This is a positive transport/geometry-admission probe, not population-scale */ /* proof, candidate accuracy, or E5 closure. Snowflake validates the decoded */ /* base64 digest before Canon independently validates it again. */ /* Fresh file-exact 2026-09-01 result (success envelope query_id null): 148 */ /* eligible PIP rows, one 29-vertex seeded selection, and decoded digest match. */ /* The emitted GEOMETRY_REQUEST was consumed by the public Canon command; the */ /* resulting fixed-point receipt is recorded in the measurement README. */ WITH params AS (SELECT CAST('dd644d67-070c-4824-a2a6-bbc8b625a402' AS VARCHAR) AS bridge_build_id, CAST('39049' AS VARCHAR) AS county_fips, CAST('hub-de09f99cce0bcae7142d6d2e26582fd3-25' AS VARCHAR) AS parcel_release, CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AS parcel_release_dt, CAST('canon-e5-franklin-live-geometry-2026-09-01-v0' AS VARCHAR) AS selection_seed, CAST(8 AS DECIMAL(9, 0)) AS blocking_h3_resolution, CAST(9 AS DECIMAL(9, 0)) AS ownership_h3_resolution, CAST(9 AS DECIMAL(9, 0)) AS source_decimal_places, CAST(10000 AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS source_grid_feet, CAST(10000000 AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS max_abs_coordinate_mm, CAST(10000 AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS max_vertices_per_geometry, CAST(10000000 AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS max_geometry_bytes_per_tile), subjects AS (SELECT property_key, ST_MAKEPOINT(MIN(longitude), MIN(latitude)) AS point_geog, H3_POINT_TO_CELL_STRING(ST_MAKEPOINT(MIN(longitude), MIN(latitude)), (SELECT blocking_h3_resolution FROM params)) AS point_h3_r8, H3_POINT_TO_CELL_STRING(ST_MAKEPOINT(MIN(longitude), MIN(latitude)), (SELECT ownership_h3_resolution FROM params)) AS point_h3_r9 FROM EDGAR_DB.PROPERTY_MART.LOAN_ISSUANCE_PROPERTY WHERE build_id = (SELECT bridge_build_id FROM params) AND county_fips = (SELECT county_fips FROM params) AND NOT property_key IS NULL AND NOT latitude IS NULL AND NOT longitude IS NULL GROUP BY property_key HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TO_CHAR(latitude) || '|' || TO_CHAR(longitude)) = 1), pip AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.property_key, s.point_h3_r9, c.provider_feature_id FROM subjects AS s JOIN EDGAR_DB.SOURCE.FRANKLIN_COUNTY_AUDITOR_PARCELS_FEATURE_H3_COVERAGE AS c ON c.release = (SELECT parcel_release FROM params) AND c.release_dt = (SELECT parcel_release_dt FROM params) AND c.county_fips = (SELECT county_fips FROM params) AND c.h3_resolution = (SELECT blocking_h3_resolution FROM params) AND c.h3_cell = s.point_h3_r8 AND c.h3_key_status = 'valid' JOIN EDGAR_DB.SOURCE.FRANKLIN_COUNTY_AUDITOR_PARCELS_HOT AS p ON p.release = c.release AND p.release_dt = c.release_dt AND p.county_fips = c.county_fips AND p.provider_feature_id = c.provider_feature_id AND NOT p.geom_geog IS NULL AND p.geom_parse_status = 'parsed' AND p.source_geometry_validity = 'valid' WHERE ST_CONTAINS(p.geom_geog, s.point_geog)), eligible AS (SELECT p.property_key, p.point_h3_r9, p.provider_feature_id, e.source_archive_sha256, e.source_geom_wkb, e.source_geom_wkb_sha256, e.source_geom_srid, e.source_crs_identifier, e.geometry_evidence_contract_version, e.transform_execution_id, e.transform_definition_id, e.source_vertex_count, FLOOR(e.source_bbox_xmin / (SELECT source_grid_feet FROM params)) * (SELECT source_grid_feet FROM params) AS source_origin_x, FLOOR(e.source_bbox_ymin / (SELECT source_grid_feet FROM params)) * (SELECT source_grid_feet FROM params) AS source_origin_y, SHA2((SELECT selection_seed FROM params) || '|' || p.property_key || '|' || p.provider_feature_id, 256) AS selection_rank, COUNT(*) OVER () AS eligible_rows FROM pip AS p JOIN EDGAR_DB.SOURCE.FRANKLIN_COUNTY_AUDITOR_PARCELS_GEOMETRY_EVIDENCE_EXT AS e ON e.release = (SELECT parcel_release FROM params) AND e.release_dt = (SELECT parcel_release_dt FROM params) AND e.county =
